tasks.description: Hold Unitree G1 in an upright standing posture at the current location.
Adjust Unitree G1 to the specified lower body height and hold upright at the current location.
Move Unitree G1 forward in its initial body-yaw direction for a bounded distance, then stop upright.
Move Unitree G1 laterally in its initial body-yaw frame for a bounded distance, then stop upright.
Move both Unitree G1 arms to the specified upper-body joint posture and hold it.
